news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.6% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Limited Announces Resignation of Ramasamy Jeevanandam as Managing Director
news.body: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Limited announced the resignation of Mr. Ramasamy Jeevanandam (DIN: 07046442) as the Managing Director of the Company due to health and personal issues. He will continue to serve in his current position of Managing Director till the appointment of a new Managing Director for the Company. The effective date of his resignation shall be as agreed between him and the Board of Directors, and the same will be notified separately. Over the past 11 years, Mr. Ramasamy Jeevanandam has served as HOEC's Executive Director & Chief Financial Officer for more than 8.5 years and has also led HOEC as the Managing Director for the last 2 years. During his tenure he has made significant contributions to the growth of the Company's portfolio.
